# docs.paypal.ai documentation — Growth — Payouts

> 17 page(s) of docs.paypal.ai documentation — Growth under Payouts. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Payouts

- [Customize Payouts API integration](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/payouts/customize/customize-payouts-api-integration.md): You can use the procedures in this section to customize your Payouts API integration to support global payments, optimize API responses, and ensure reliable payout processing.
- [Customize Web UI payouts](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/payouts/customize/customize-web-ui-payouts.md): You can use the procedures in this section to improve payout governance and global payout capabilities using the Web UI.
- [Collect recipient information with AAC](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/payouts/customize/integrate-aac.md): You can use Assisted Account Creation (AAC) to let your customers use their PayPal account to log in or sign up on your site.
- [Cancel or reverse payouts](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/payouts/manage-payouts/cancel-reverse-payouts.md): You can use the procedure and information in this section to cancel unclaimed payouts and understand payout reversals.
- [Handle unclaimed payouts](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/payouts/manage-payouts/handle-unclaimed-payouts.md): When recipients do not claim their payouts, the status of the payout items remains `UNCLAIMED`. Typically, unclaimed payouts can occur due to:
- [View reports and transaction logs](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/payouts/manage-payouts/reports-transaction-logs.md): You can access the reports and transaction logs for payouts using your PayPal business account.
- [Track payout item status](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/payouts/manage-payouts/track-payout-item-status.md): You can track the status of the individual payout items in a payout batch.
- [PayPal Payouts overview](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/payouts/overview.md): PayPal Payouts helps you send secure, mass payouts to multiple recipients using just their email, phone number, PayPal ID, or Venmo handle.
- [Send, track, and manage payouts to multiple recipients](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/payouts/paypal-enterprise-payouts.md): Payouts helps businesses pay multiple recipients—vendors, contractors, employees, or customers—across regions in various currencies.
- [Plan your integration](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/payouts/plan-your-integration.md): Ensure you understand the integration patterns and payout methods available, before using PayPal Payouts to efficiently send payouts to your recipients.
- [Countries and supported features](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/payouts/reference/countries-supported-features.md): You can use the following information to review country and currency requirements before sending payouts.
- [Payouts API - test values](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/payouts/reference/payouts-api-test-values.md): You can use predefined test values to simulate a variety of positive and negative API responses.
- [Payouts SDK](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/payouts/reference/payouts-sdk.md): You can use the PayPal Payouts SDK for Java or Python to work with the Payouts REST API.
- [Use large-batch file transfer](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/payouts/send-money/use-large-batch-file-transfer.md): You can use this pattern to pay more than 15,000 people at once with a single payment file.
- [Use Payouts API](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/payouts/send-money/use-payouts-api.md): You can use this pattern to send payouts to multiple recipients with a single API call.
- [Use Web UI](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/payouts/send-money/use-web-ui.md): You can use this pattern to send up to 5,000 payouts at once by uploading a `.csv` file in your PayPal business account dashboard.
- [Set up accounts and environment for payouts](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/payouts/set-up.md): You can use the procedures in this section to ensure that your accounts and environment are set up to send payouts.
